regime_context: The detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the dominant momentum leader with strong trend durability (0.88) and broad participation. Semiconductors are a crowded challenger. The absolute trend gate has historically not helped drawdown control in China A-shares, so this thematic allocation is experimental/display-only. The macro backdrop is geopolitics-heavy with high unscheduled news flow, adding uncertainty.
emerging_watch: Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 6, score 0.087, eligible, durability 0.77) could emerge if it surpasses Semiconductors in momentum score and holds durability above 0.7. Kill: if it fails to cross a score of 2.0 within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The theme holds the top momentum rank, high durability, and broad breadth without crowding. Given sustained industrial policy focus on AI, we lean that it will continue to lead the A-share market barring a trend break.
theses.dissent: The historic inability of the absolute-trend gate to control drawdown in this market warns of mean-reversion risk; any policy shift or profit-taking could abruptly reverse the leadership.

falsifier.text: If the weekly durability bar falls below 0.75 or the theme's relative strength turns negative for 5 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Autos & NEV Makers
theses.thesis: This theme is near the bottom of the momentum ranking with negative score, no breadth, and extremely low durability, indicating persistent underperformance. Overcapacity and price wars remain headwinds.
theses.dissent: A sudden policy catalyst (e.g., new subsidies) or a short-squeeze given the deeply under-owned status could trigger a sharp rebound.

falsifier.text: If the Autos theme score turns positive and durability crosses above 0.5 for a full week.

theses.subject: Consumer Electronics
theses.thesis: Ranked 3rd, the theme benefits from AI-driven hardware demand with solid trend health and lower crowding than Semiconductors. It may offer a less extended way to capture tech momentum.
theses.dissent: The theme may not differentiate meaningfully from the broad AI Compute trend and could suffer if consumer demand weakens globally.

falsifier.text: If the theme's relative strength falls below the CSI 300 for 5 consecutive days or its score drops below 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
